data.name: Caption_Cell
data.comment: Caption under a filmstrip tile for a cell of unknown type.

data.name: Caption_Code
data.comment: Caption under a filmstrip tile for a code cell with no language set.

data.name: Filmstrip_Empty
data.value: This notebook has no cells yet. Switch to the Notebook layout to add some.
data.comment: Text in the filmstrip when the notebook has no cells. 'Notebook' names the built-in layout.

data.name: Hud_Exit
data.comment: Tooltip on the presenter's close button. Esc names the key and stays as written.

data.name: Hud_Next
data.comment: Tooltip on the presenter's forward arrow.

data.name: Hud_Previous
data.comment: Tooltip on the presenter's back arrow.

data.name: Layout_Description
data.value: Slide-deck authoring layout: a filmstrip of cell previews, an editor and output split view, and a full-screen presenter mode with per-cell source/output control.
data.comment: Second line of the sample's entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_DisplayName
data.comment: Label in the layout picker. Stays as written.

data.name: Layout_Name
data.comment: Name of the sample extension as listed in the Extensions panel. 'Slide Studio' is the sample's name and stays as written.

data.name: Output_ImageAlt
data.comment: Alternative text of an image output drawn on a slide, read by screen readers.

data.name: Pane_Cell
data.comment: Header of the editor pane, the left half of the workspace.

data.name: Pane_NoOutput
data.value: No output yet. Run the cell to see its result here.
data.comment: Output pane text when the selected cell has not produced output.

data.name: Pane_Output
data.comment: Header of the output pane, the right half of the workspace.

data.name: Pane_OutputOnSlide
data.comment: Checkbox label in the output pane header.

data.name: Pane_OutputOnSlide_Tip
data.value: Show this cell's output on its slide
data.comment: Tooltip on the Output on slide checkbox.

data.name: Pane_SelectCell
data.value: Select a cell in the filmstrip.
data.comment: Editor pane text when no cell is selected.

data.name: Pane_SourceOnSlide
data.comment: Checkbox label in the editor pane header.

data.name: Pane_SourceOnSlide_Tip
data.value: Show this cell's source on its slide
data.comment: Tooltip on the Source on slide checkbox.

data.name: Props_Include
data.comment: Toggle label in the cell properties panel.

data.name: Props_Include_Hint
data.value: Whether this cell appears as a slide in presenter view.
data.comment: Help text under the Include in presenter toggle.

data.name: Props_Section
data.comment: Title of this layout's section in the cell properties panel.

data.name: Props_Section_Description
data.value: How this cell appears in Slide Studio's presenter view.
data.comment: Description under the section title in the cell properties panel.

data.name: Props_ShowOutput
data.comment: Toggle label in the cell properties panel.

data.name: Props_ShowOutput_Hint
data.value: Show the cell's output on its slide.
data.comment: Help text under the Show output on slide toggle.

data.name: Props_ShowSource
data.comment: Toggle label in the cell properties panel.

data.name: Props_ShowSource_Hint
data.value: Show the cell's source on its slide.
data.comment: Help text under the Show source on slide toggle.

data.name: Tile_Include_Tip
data.comment: Tooltip on the checkbox in each filmstrip tile.

data.name: Toolbar_Present
data.comment: Toolbar button that opens the full-screen presenter.

data.name: Toolbar_Present_None_Tip
data.value: No cells are included in the presenter view
data.comment: Tooltip on the disabled Present button when no cell is marked for the deck.

data.name: Toolbar_SlideCount_One
data.comment: Count in the toolbar for exactly one slide. {0} is the number.

data.name: Toolbar_SlideCount_Other
data.comment: Count in the toolbar for any other number of slides. {0} is the number.

data.name: Toolbar_Title
data.comment: Title at the left of the layout's toolbar. Stays as written.
